what: Costco runs membership warehouse stores selling groceries and household goods in bulk at very low markups, in the US and abroad.
customers: More than 70 million paying member households and businesses.
money: about 2% of revenue but a large share of profit
annual Gold Star and Executive memberships
moat: Membership loyalty (renewal rates around 90%), huge buying power and a limited assortment that keeps costs and prices low.
opportunities: Membership fee income is almost pure profit and renews at over 90%
Return on invested capital of 20% with cash exceeding debt
Its own Kirkland Signature brand earns better margins than national brands
watch: Membership renewal rates and comparable sales excluding fuel.
